label: Placing
try: Round 1 after the intro, a Barracks armed. The dotted ground is your build range, from what stood when the round opened, and a Barracks needs only one tile on it: it may hang over the edge. The dim ticks round each Barracks are its room, where nothing may stand; move it beside the standing one and it is refused, too close. Press d: under THE MISSION, Barracks room sets one tile or two.

label: Range next round
try: A Turret planned at the edge of the build range, and a second one armed. The dotted ground has not grown: a building gives range from the round after it stands, and its card says 3, next round. Tap below the first Turret: outside your build range. Taking a planned building away is never refused.

label: First wave
try: Round 1's battle, nothing built and no Nexus power picked. Five seconds in, four troopers come out of the Barracks together, in a row, and Vasse speaks beside her as the battle goes. Watch again with r.

label: Ranged units
try: Explore Map on a marksman: its range is drawn round it, as a Turret's reach is. Move onto a trooper and there is none, because a trooper fights hand to hand.

label: Moving trail
try: Round 2: two groups, each trail a slow line of arrows, one every three tiles, each leaving a fading copy behind as it moves. Reduced motion, in Settings, holds them still.

label: Her return
try: The Commander's cadence, on her campaign's second test level: Vasse fell in round 1, so round 2 opens on a line saying she is out, the camera on your Nexus. Press Enter, then s s to play the round without her. When it ends, press Enter: round 3 opens on her return, the light around her.
